shots.name: 1-cover.jpg
shots.notes: LAST CALL, one moment: the gold VIP ticket for the night-shift nurse at three of three, her cold dish ready on the plate — leaves, chili rings, chili-oil drizzle and sesame — noodles steaming in the wok, cold counter with bowl and sesame bottle, menu board with No Wok badge, shift timer and coins visible.

shots.name: 2-chop.jpg
shots.notes: The journey begins: the VIP ticket just arrived, nothing done yet, her greens on the chop board, cook mid-chop.

shots.name: 3-cold.jpg
shots.notes: Mid-journey: the VIP's chili and tossed greens are on the plate (two of three), the second greens mid-drizzle at the cold counter (red ring, DRIZZLING…), noodles steaming in wok 1 for the next hot ticket, cook at the cold counter.

shots.name: 4-serve.jpg
shots.notes: The payoff: the VIP's cold plate complete with all three components, serve mid-flight with the +$45 PERFECT popup, cook beside the plate (the hatch approach would put him on the cold counter).
